legacy.evidence: **ORB-10754** (tycho, 11 systems, Karachentsev program + Virgo/Fornax): with independent masses, measured turnaround radii sit at 0.43–0.83× (median ≈ 0.55) the budget radius — right scale, wrong coefficient. Data track the ΛCDM zero-velocity formula (≈ 1.0), whose matter/Λ factors the pure-Hubble idealization here drops.
